## Step 2 · Excel practice: SUM, AVERAGE, MAX and $ {.study}

- **SUM** adds, **AVERAGE** gives the average (the total ÷ how many),
  **MAX** gives the biggest: `=SUM(B2:B6)`, `=AVERAGE(B2:B6)`,
  `=MAX(B2:B6)`.
- Copy a formula down with the **fill handle**: B2 moves to B3, B4 …
- A cell with `$` (for example `$E$2`) stays the same in every row.

{{< sim file="sims/excel-lab-review.html" poster="sims/excel-lab-review.png" title="Excel Lab: a week of the book stand" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · References"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="=B3\*\$F\$2|=B2\*\$F\$1"}
C2 has =B2\*\$F\$1. You copy it to C3. Which formula is in C3?
:   =B3\*\$F\$1

    Why: B2 moves one row down, and \$F\$1 stays.
:::
:::
